title: Decrementing a counter word
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean word and let $r$ be a natural number strictly less than the number represented by the binary digits of $w$. Then the fixed-width decrement of the word obtained after $r$ counter iterations is defined and equals the word obtained after $r+1$ counter iterations.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is strictly less than the natural number represented by the binary digits of $w$
